problem_statement: OpenThread lacks a generic helper that builds a bit-mask with a given number of lowest bits set to 1 for any unsigned integer type (8/16/32/64-bit). Callers want a MaskForBitSize<T>(n) that returns a mask with the lowest n bits set, saturating to the all-ones value of the type when n meets or exceeds the type's bit width (so requesting more bits than the type has does not overflow the shift), and returns 0 for n of 0. Add this utility and exercise it across uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t and uint64_t for representative widths including boundary and over-width inputs.
